data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They successfully delivered initial LCA targets and maintained strong EBITDA margins, but frequently drop guidance or let timelines slip on major orders, revenue growth, and aircraft production programs without consistent follow-through.

lines.line: Promised 26-27% EBITDA margin; delivered 31% in Q4 FY23.
Promised 8-9% ROH growth; actual reached 14.4% in FY27.
Promised Rs. 15,000 crore cash balance; target was dropped.
Promised 3 LCA Mark1A units; delivered 3 units in Q4 FY23.
Promised 10% revenue growth; missed with 7% in Q4 FY26.
Promised INR 48,000 crores orders; target was dropped.
Promised HTT-40 delivery starting Sept 2025; currently slipping.
Promised AL-31FP order within 8 months; target was dropped.
Guided INR 14,000-15,000 crores capex over 5 years; on track.
Promised manpower cost at 16%; target was dropped.
Promised 97 LCA contract before March 2025; target was dropped.
Promised 40% manufacturing revenue mix; target was dropped.
Promised 31% EBITDA margin; slipped to 30% in Q4 FY26.
Promised GE F414 deal in financial year; currently slipping.
Promised Tejas Mark-2 flight in Q1 '26; delayed.
Promised Tejas Mark-2 certification in 2029-30; pending.
Promised production rate of 24 LCA Mark 1A; on track.
Promised production rate of 30 LCA Mark 1A; pending.
Promised INR 12,000 crores infrastructure investment by 2030; pending.
Promised INR 90,000 crores orders in 2 years; pending.
Promised Tejas Mark II prototype roll out by March 2027; pending.
